sloka: कुञ्जराश्च खरोष्ट्राश्च गोश्वाश्च मृगपक्षिण: ।बभूवु: सुभृतास्तत्र नान्यो ह्यन्यमकल्पयत् ॥ २.९१.६४॥
transliteration: kuñjarāśca kharoṣṭrāśca gośvāśca mṛgapakṣiṇa: ।babhūvu: subhṛtāstatra nānyo hyanyamakalpayat ॥ 2.91.64॥

translations.english: Glancing at the ambrosial food, a desire arose in the minds of those soldiers to eat once again although they had already partaken it.
